text: A metabolomics feature is identified by matching its accurate mass and MS/MS fragmentation spectrum to a spectral library, but no authentic chemical standard was run alongside the sample to confirm retention time. Under the Metabolomics Standards Initiative confidence levels, this is:
choices: Level 1 — confirmed identification (matches an authentic chemical standard)
Level 4 — unknown but reproducibly detected feature
Level 2 — putative annotation (library MS/MS match, no standard)
explanation: Level 2 corresponds exactly to this scenario: a library MS/MS match provides a putative identification without a co-run authentic standard. Level 1 requires confirmation against an authentic standard run alongside the sample, Level 3 reflects only compound-class-level confidence from spectral similarity, and Level 4 applies to a feature that is reproducibly detected but not annotated to any compound at all.
